description: Sähköisen asioinnin ja asianhallinnan arkkitehtuuri is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ELY-keskusten ja TE-toimistojen kehittämis- ja hallintokeskus. E-service vision, operations and information architecture. Abbreviation, 4 June 2015. Coverage: ELY-keskusten ja TE-toimistojen kehittämis- ja hallintokeskus. The portal shows the English title as "E-services and case management architecture" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ELY-keskusten ja TE-toimistojen kehittämis- ja hallintokeskus. Its keywords include sähköinen asiointi, asianhallinta. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PPTX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
